adjudication_rule:
X3's SUBLINEAR verdict is CONFIRMED only if BOTH hold:
  (i)  it SURVIVES C2 on the fixed population, AND
  (ii) the C1 control returns LINEAR (i.e. the estimator is CAPABLE of detecting linearity).
Otherwise the verdict must be DOWNGRADED to INCONCLUSIVE, with the numbers.
composition_statement: Original SUBLINEAR survives the fixed-population control.

fixed_population_curve.set_definition: flows and pairs eligible at k=30; same population used for every k=5..30

occupancy_scope: variable population matching the original X3 sampling rule PPI_LEN >= k

original_variable_population_fit.adjudication_rule: SUBLINEAR requires power p<0.90, AIC advantage of sqrt model over linear greater than 6, and first-to-last median increment ratio >1.10; LINEAR requires p>0.95, AIC advantage of linear over sqrt greater than 6, and ratio <=1.10; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
original_variable_population_fit.fit_target: per-k median D_k over all usable service pairs at that k; the changing denominator is retained and reported rather than pooled away
original_variable_population_fit.power_model: D_k = q*k^p, p selected by numpy grid search over [0.05, 1.50]

smoothing_stability_statement: Verdict is not stable across smoothing values 0, 0.5, and 1.0.
